title: Fix Hero 'Contact Sales' CTA button rendering as raw translation key

requirements.summary: Fix the 'Contact Sales' CTA button in HeroSection to render human-readable translations instead of raw translation keys in all three languages (English, Hindi, Marathi)
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Contact Sales' CTA button in HeroSection renders the human-readable label 'Contact Sales' when the language is set to English.
The button renders the correct Hindi translation when the language is set to Hindi — no raw key or artifact is visible.
The button renders the correct Marathi translation when the language is set to Marathi — no raw key or artifact is visible.
The translation key used in HeroSection JSX exactly matches the key present in translations.ts for all three language codes.
No raw translation key string (e.g., 'Hero.ctaContactSale', 'Hero.ctacontact', or similar) is ever visible on screen for this button.
No other HeroSection content, layout, or functionality is changed.

file_operations.description: Review the current translation key used for the 'Contact Sales' CTA button in the JSX. Correct the key if it is malformed (e.g., 'Hero.ctaContactSale', 'Hero.ctacontact', or similar) to match the exact key defined in translations.ts. Ensure the button's text content uses the t() function with the corrected key and that no other content, styling, or link target is changed.

Locate the translation key for the 'Contact Sales' CTA button used by HeroSection (e.g., 'Hero.ctaContactSales' or the corrected key identified in HeroSection.tsx). Ensure that this key exists in the nested translations object for all three language codes (en, hi, mr) and that each value is a plain human-readable string: 'Contact Sales' for English, the correct Hindi translation, and the correct Marathi translation. Remove any raw JSON syntax, escaped characters, template literal artifacts, or incorrect key names that would cause a raw key to display on screen.
